title: Claude Code expands video editing with ChatKart plugin for #claudecode #chatkart #aivideoediting
description: Claude Code introduced a powerful video editing feature integrated with ChatKart’s plugin. This setup allows users to edit videos directly on an AI-powered timeline, enabling tasks like removing dead air, cutting repeats, adding captions, B-roll, motion graphics, music, and voiceovers—all in one interface. Unlike typical AI video tools that generate clips or constrain users to templates, this combination understands editing requests, executes them, and still offers full manual control. It streamlines workflows by using footage from sources like Google Drive and lets users save reusable editing skills across projects. This advancement marks a shift from AI-generated clips to AI-assisted editing of existing footage, promising greater efficiency and creative flexibility for content creators and video editors. #ClaudeCode #ChatKart #AIvideoEditing #VideoEditingAI #AItools #ContentCreationTech #VideoEditingWorkflow #Opus5 #AIVideoTools #CreativeAI #GoogleDriveEditing #MotionGraphicsAI #VideoEditingInnovation #AIContentCreation #TechInnovation
